method.pr_association: GitHub REST pull-request history; exact current tip SHA match required for merged/closed-unmerged classification.
method.deletion_rule: No classification in this snapshot authorizes deletion. MERGED_PR_HEAD_PENDING_CITATION_CHECK still requires citation/provenance/content review.
method.squash_rule: Commit ancestry alone is not treated as content-equivalence or deletion proof.
method.ancestry_rule: branch->main compare with status=ahead and behind_by=0 is recorded as ancestor-of-main evidence only; it is not deletion authority.
method.unique_delta_rule: For residual ambiguous refs, main->branch compare was inspected. Any ahead_by>0 delta is preserved as KEEP_UNMERGED_UNIQUE_DELTA unless a later explicit content-equivalence review supersedes it.
method.citation_search: Exact branch-ref searches were run against default-branch indexed repository content. Twelve surviving refs matched only the frozen evidence-anchor migration surfaces and have durable main checkpoints. No-match search is bounded evidence, not proof of global absence.
